observation: The literature and source reviews found substantial prior art and a bounded public three-family source contract. During implementation review, a global all-fold validation search was identified as temporally unsafe because later validation could influence earlier tests. No S12 market bytes or outcomes had been accessed.
hypothesized_cause: A causally delayed learned router may improve joint distribution forecasts, but additional flexibility and a leaky model-selection calendar could create spurious gains unless selection, controls, completeness and evidence identity are enforced prospectively.
change: Freeze P0v2 with no broad novelty claim; restrict all 24 configurations to Fold A validation across three families and two seeds; require a complete 144-cell source-current selection receipt before any of 120 fixed cells; implement the router, controls, exact scores, checkpoint/resume, no-overwrite bundles, complete analysis and Kaggle launcher.
predicted_effect: P0v2 should distinguish learned routing from controls without later-fold model-selection leakage. No positive market result is predicted, and missing cells must block interpretation.
discriminating_experiment: After actual Kaggle qualification and exact data admission, consume all 144 Fold-A search cells once, freeze one selection, then run 120 fixed family-fold-seed cells. Require at least five-percent energy improvement over S11 and the selected strongest non-FREM control, Holm-corrected positive uncertainty, 75-percent positive folds, no negative family and variogram noninferiority.
